critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/imported_station_artwork.py:44 _load() only queries imported_radio_stations by id, but /api/radio/station/{sid} resolves via a broader resolver — so a station reachable at /api/radio/station/{sid} may 404 on /api/imported-stations/{sid}/artwork/*. In this env admin got 404 on GET /api/imported-stations/imp_96063f25060111e8ae yet 200 on /api/radio/station/imp_96063f25060111e8ae. The owner UI happens to work anyway because it reads the station shape from /api/radio/station and only POSTs to /api/imported-stations/.../artwork/generate, and the POST resolver DOES find the station. Consider harmonizing the two ID resolvers to avoid divergence in owner-tools that hit BOTH routes.

backend/routes/news_radio.py:66 The /queue endpoint sorts by 'pubDate' but no compound index is confirmed on {summary_script, pubDate desc}. With 5,000+ news_articles this can degrade — verify an index exists (Phase R news-radio indexes ready log line at server.py:6592 suggests one, but the projection query is un-hinted).

backend/routes/news_radio.py:80 audio_url fallback chain uses `news_audio_url` then `tts_audio_url` — good — but there's no explicit 48h-freshness filter here despite this iteration being described as 'durable object-storage read alignment'; the 48h-cache is presumably applied at write time (in news_radio_renderer). Add an inline TTL guard (or a projection filter that excludes stale audio_url) for hardening.

frontend/src/LiveRadioStation.jsx (owner-artwork block): the UI displays 'New artwork is live' by relying on the poll seeing artwork_status=='complete'. If the backend background task fails, ARTWORK_STATUS goes to 'failed' but the status chip in this run only had the happy-path text. Confirm there's a testable 'failed' state (data-testid=owner-art-status text differs) so QA can regression-test the error path.
